problem_or_opportunity.summary: The ALVIRA public marketing homepage reads as a series of separately-designed bands rather than one document. Copy and colour are strong; the composition is not.
root_causes: No shared grid: 8 major headings resolve to 6 distinct left edges, including two near-miss pairs (504 vs 528, 178 vs 120) that read as misalignment rather than intent.
Display type set below its usable measure: 4 headings at 60px render in 360-437px columns (~5-6 characters per line), forcing 4-line blocks with heavy rag.
Gap in the type scale: sizes jump 24px -> 60px with nothing between, so the page has no middle voice.
Inconsistent display weight: H1 is weight 600 while every H2 is weight 400 at the same 60px.
Ad-hoc vertical rhythm: 4 of 8 sections carry zero vertical padding and rely on internal spacing.
Seven hardcoded near-identical grey hex values bypass the existing ink/mineral/warm-gray token system.

Header crowding: 9 interactive items at 73.4% ink occupancy of the 1280px inner container, with near-uniform 15-16px gaps that prevent the bar grouping into navigation and account/action blocks; the 375px branding block is 29% of the container and the hamburger does not take over until 760px.
explicitly_not_a_problem: Copy quality and voice are strong and are out of scope.
Mobile (<=640px) is already well balanced and must not change.
Light and dark themes both render correctly at identical height (5743px).
Contrast is broadly compliant: 104 of 106 text nodes pass WCAG AA.

originating_signal.method: live-deployment inspection at 1440x900 and 390x844, deviceScaleFactor 2, headless Chromium with native sandbox enabled, measured after document.fonts.ready

priority.rationale: Pre-launch presentation quality on a public surface. Not a functional or security defect and not launch-blocking on its own. Final priority is the human owner's call, not the reviewing agent's.

evidence.name: display-measure
evidence.finding: 4 of the >=56px headings run in columns under 640px: 379px, 360px, 433px, 437px

evidence.name: target-grid
evidence.finding: 12 columns, 1200px container, 24px gutter, all sections starting at col 1 (x=120) or col 5 (x=528)

evidence.name: contrast-baseline
evidence.finding: 106 text nodes checked against composited backgrounds; 2 below WCAG AA: 9px header tagline at 3.99:1, 10px 'Without ALVIRA' label at 3.83:1
evidence.note: Baseline to protect. No change may reduce any text below 4.5:1, or 3:1 at >=24px.

evidence.name: header-crowding
evidence.finding: 9 interactive items, 73.4% ink occupancy, gaps 133/16/15/16/16/33/16/16; raising all header text to 12px adds +108px ink (73.4% -> 81.8%); removing two nav links returns it to 70.2%

desired_outcome.statement: The homepage reads as one document on a single grid, with display type set at a usable measure and a type scale that has a middle register, without any change to copy, palette, theme behaviour, or the mobile layout.
observable_change: Every H1/H2 at 1440px sits on one of exactly two left-edge axes.
No heading >=56px renders in a column narrower than 640px.
No display heading wraps beyond 3 lines at 1440px.
Type scale includes 32px and 40px steps; prose body is 16px.
All headings >=40px share one font weight.
Every section uses symmetric vertical padding drawn from two spacing tokens.
The seven hardcoded grey hex values are replaced by three semantic tokens with dark: counterparts.
Header reduced to three primary nav links with a ~40px navigation/actions separator, ink occupancy at or below 72%, and the hamburger breakpoint raised to ~1000px.

preserve_contract: Zero changes to user-facing copy. Every headline, paragraph, label and button string stays byte-identical.
No changes to the colour palette, brand teal, logo, or light/dark theme behaviour.
No section reordering, additions, or removals.
No changes to the mobile layout below the md breakpoint.
No new CSS framework, component library, or animation library.
Repository-local instructions and regression boundaries in tk-ap/ALVIRA take precedence over this brief.
constraints.cross_product_write_rule: This item is authored by the workforce and proposes work owned by alvira-meos. It must not be implemented as a silent direct edit. Explicit task authorization on tk-ap/ALVIRA is required before execution.

browser_execution.rule: The executing Codex agent must not launch a browser to verify this work.
browser_execution.basis: adapters/codex/browser.py fails closed. prepare_codex_browser_execution unconditionally appends the reason 'provider receipt authentication is not implemented; caller trust flags are insufficient', so the decision is BLOCKED even when a complete attestation is supplied (tests/test_codex_browser_adapter.py::test_caller_authenticated_complete_attestation_is_denied).
browser_execution.consequence: Rendered-layout assertions are human- or authorized-surface-produced evidence, supplied back to the work item. Codex verifies only the statically checkable criteria.
browser_execution.never: Do not pass --no-sandbox to any Chromium-family browser under any circumstance.

constraints.aesthetic_authority: Quality railguards may reject unsupported or low-quality work but hold no aesthetic authority over deliberate ALVIRA product direction. Where this brief and repository-local art direction conflict, the repository wins and the conflict is escalated, not resolved unilaterally.
constraints.product_direction_status: Post-Revision 11 working hypothesis, not owner-ratified direction. Per AGENTS.md, revisions after 11 are team working hypotheses unless the owner explicitly ratifies them. The measurements in the brief are verified facts; the proposed grid, type scale and hierarchy changes are recommendations awaiting ratification.
repository_local_rules: Branch from latest main as codex/<short-task-name>; never commit or push to main.
Open a draft pull request; satisfy the AGENTS.md Merge Gate including desktop, mobile, light and dark verification.
Design-reference images live under design/brand-references/ and must never be loaded by the production website.
Free-tier smoke account acceptance applies only if a change reaches an authenticated surface.
constraints.nav_architecture_note: Removing Reflect and Use elsewhere from the primary navigation touches product-surface architecture and requires owner ratification beyond the compositional tasks. AGENTS.md defines Bridge as a gated secondary capability that stays visible but subordinate and says main navigation may link to it, so removal from primary nav is permitted, not a departure. Both remain reachable in-page and at their own routes.

human_oversight.basis: policies/HANDOFF_POLICY.md — 'If the acceptance question is materially aesthetic or experiential, preserve a human acceptance gate. Agents may surface evidence and specific concerns but must not manufacture visual approval.'
human_oversight.what_the_agent_may_do: Surface before/after renders and the mechanical assertion results as evidence.
human_oversight.what_the_agent_may_not_do: Declare the visual outcome accepted, or treat passing mechanical assertions as proof that the page looks right.

acceptance_criteria: Every H1/H2 at a 1440px viewport resolves to one of exactly two left-edge axes.
No heading at or above 56px renders in a column narrower than 640px.
No display heading wraps to more than 3 lines at 1440px.
The type scale exposes 32px and 40px steps and prose body copy renders at 16px.
Every heading at or above 40px shares a single font weight.
Every section has non-zero symmetric vertical padding drawn from --section-y or --section-y-lg.
No arbitrary grey hex values remain in homepage class attributes; three semantic tokens with dark: counterparts are used instead.
Hero emphasis favours 'The harder part is knowing what matters.' over the first sentence.
'With ALVIRA' is visually distinguished from 'Without ALVIRA' by more than a label and a rule.
Header nav and header tagline render at 12px or larger, both at 4.5:1 or better.
The two known WCAG AA failures are resolved and no new contrast failure is introduced.
git diff shows zero changes to user-facing strings.
Rendered page height remains identical between light and dark themes.
Mobile layout at 390x844 is visually unchanged from the current deployment.
Header reduced to 3 primary nav links (How it helps, Context, Pricing) with a ~40px navigation/actions separator.
Header ink occupancy at 1440px is at or below 72%.
Hamburger breakpoint raised to approximately 1000px.
Task 8 (header type sizing) is not shipped without Task 9 (header crowding); the two are coupled.
Producer has run the quality-railguard self-check per policies/QUALITY_RAILGUARDS.md before handoff.
Human product owner has recorded visual acceptance.
